title: WordPress Plugins
meta: A custom WordPress plugin built to coding standards with an admin screen and clean uninstall. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Custom WordPress plugins built to WordPress standards
overview: When no ready-made plugin does the job, we write one. You describe the feature, we agree a clear scope in writing and then build a plugin that follows WordPress coding standards, keeps data safe and removes cleanly if you ever uninstall it. It comes with a settings screen in your dashboard, where needed, and works with your current theme. You receive the plugin file, the source code and a short guide.

A fuller plugin with front-end screens, an API and documentation.

faq: Do I own the plugin code?
Yes. When the order is complete you receive the full source and the right to use, change and sell it. We do not tie it to any licence from us.
Will the plugin keep working after WordPress updates?
We test on the current WordPress and PHP versions and write standard code that is built to survive updates. Future major changes may need small fixes, which our maintenance service can handle.
Can you list it in the WordPress plugin directory?
We can prepare it to the directory rules, but the review is done by the WordPress team and approval is not in our control. Many clients just use it privately.
What if a plugin already does this?
We check first and tell you honestly. Using an existing plugin is cheaper and often better, and we can configure it for you instead.
